mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_yaopenghao_cart_items WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flay = '0'

SELECT ci.id, ci.user_id AS userId, ci.product_id AS productId, ci.quantity, ci.subtotal, ci.create_date AS createDate, ci.update_date AS updateDate, ci.del_flay AS delFlay, p.name AS productName, CAST(p.price AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS productPrice, SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.images, ',', 1) AS productImage FROM t_yaopenghao_cart_items ci JOIN t_yaopenghao_products p ON ci.product_id = p.id WHERE ci.user_id = #{userId} AND ci.del_flay = '0'
